posts.author: pothi
posts.text: UPI MDR on Capital Market Transactions — I understand that nothing can be free forever. So far, the traders (and AMC) may have paid the fee for the (free) equity delivery. In the future, the equity delivery may pay for UPI MDR charges. The actual charges for equity delivery may be higher than MDR charges. Or the equity delivery volume is too high compared to volume of UPI transactions. Mutual fund houses may directly pass the MDR (+GST) to the customers. Or include it in the expense ratio.

posts.author: nithin_kumrr
posts.text: UPI MDR on Capital Market Transactions — If you’ve been following the UPI MDR developments, you’d know that businesses now have to pay to receive money on UPI. For broking, this gets tricky. A UPI transfer doesn’t necessarily mean the client will transact. Sharing @nithin 's tweet on this: I think MDR on UPI was probably inevitable at some point, especially given how widespread UPI adoption has become.
